note.zh: 镜像帝国的首都被吞噬，传送门沉寂；此后不再有贸易涨落。
note.en: The mirror empire's capital is consumed and the portal falls silent; no further trade swings.

notes.zh: 审阅注：这是“传送门”事件（colony.3005，目前在另一个故事中）镜像次元结果的后续插曲：与镜像帝国通商后，每五年随机检查一次贸易。正常时 60无事/10上升/10下降；偏低时 20/20/10；偏高时 30/10/20。上升使贸易修正提高一级（已最高则给一次性奖励）。
notes.en: Review note: a recurring interlude after the mirror-dimension outcome of The Doorway (colony.3005, currently in another story). Every five years one trading empire is checked: at normal trade 60 nothing / 10 up / 10 down; low 20/20/10; high 30/10/20. 'Up' raises the trade modifier one level (or pays a bonus at the top).

notes.zh: 审阅注：贸易已处于低位时，每次下降使危机计数加一；计数达到5后再下降，镜像帝国陷入危机，1825–3650天后发来紧急广播。
notes.en: Review note: each decline while trade is already low adds to a crisis counter; once it reaches 5 the next decline puts the mirror empire in crisis and the emergency broadcast follows 1825–3650 days later.

scope.en: The mirror-dimension trade interludes (hidden 3029/3030, 3031, 3032) and the emergency broadcast 3033.

sources: events/colony_events_3.txt:1825-2001 (dportal_trader set by The Doorway's mirror outcome)
uncertain: The 3031 and 3032 cards are alternatives of the same five-yearly check and can recur in any order; the tree shows them as two entries.
